title: Local Marketing: A Complete Guide | Salesforce UK

facts.fact: In the page's hypothetical bakery example, a $1,000 broad online advertising campaign across the entire city reached 10,000 people and produced 100 customers, a 1% conversion rate.
facts.quote: Imagine a small bakery invests $1,000 in a broad online advertising campaign targeting a wide audience across the entire city. This campaign reaches 10,000 people, but only 100 of them convert into customers, resulting in a conversion rate of 1%.

facts.fact: In the same hypothetical bakery example, $1,000 of targeted Facebook ads aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius reached 2,500 people and produced 200 customers, an 8% conversion rate.
facts.quote: they invest the same $1,000 in targeted Facebook ads specifically aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius of their storefront. This localized campaign reaches only 2,500 people, a quarter of the audience of the broad campaign.

facts.fact: The page defines local marketing as the strategies and tactics businesses use to promote their products or services to potential customers within a specific geographic area.
facts.quote: Local marketing refers to the strategies and tactics businesses can use to promote their products or services to potential customers within a specific geographic area.

facts.fact: The Salesforce State of Marketing report draws on responses from nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.
facts.quote: See the top trends in data, AI, and more — from nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.
